0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002630_KANESENNA
0.description: Esteemed guests. You honor us with your presence. As there is much to discuss, let us begin.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002640_IXALICHIEFTAIN
1.description: Information on our taken brethren you have, yes? Hear it we would!

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002650_IXALICHIEFTAIN
2.description: Beyond forgiveness these featherless ones are! With rivers of blood shall they pay! Freed our people must be!

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002660_YSHTOLA
3.description: We too would see your kin liberated, but ere we attempt their rescue, we must first find a means to negate the risk of tempering. Without that, we will be unable even to approach the towers, let alone contend with their defenders.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002670_MERLWYB
4.description: If all else fails, I've always found cannonballs quite effective...

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002680_SAHAGINPRIEST
5.description: And what of the prisoners!? Would you see them ssslaughtered!?

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002690_ZADA
6.description: Think for a moment! Ponder, consider, think! If Merlwyb truly intended to bombard the towers, she would have done so by now. Remember, we came here to find a solution together, did we not?

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002700_MERLWYB
7.description: Y'shtola spoke of defenders. I but offered a means to clear a path, should you require it.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002710_RAUBAHN
8.description: Given the enemy's capabilities, we will all need to play our part if we are to have any chance of success. For if any here should give less than their best, it will be to the cost of every living being on this star.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002720_SAHAGINPRIEST
9.description: A Paragon, the Empire, our very gods... How can we hope to prevail against sssuch odds?

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002730_AYMERIC
10.description: That our foe is formidable none would deny, but our strengths are many and varied. In this chamber, I see masters of strategy, masters of magic, masters of the land, the air, and the sea. And together, there is nothing in creation we cannot overcome.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002760_SAHAGINPRIEST
13.description: What is it, shorewalker? Do you not express your passion thusss?

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002770_SAHAGINPRIEST
14.description: A little tricky without gills, perhaps! Pshahaha! Sssuffice it to say, I am proud to be counted amongst Eorzea's finessst. We Sssahagin will play our part!

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002780_ZADA
15.description: We kobolds have not forgotten the crimes the overdwellers committed against us in the past. But today we look to the future, as allies united in purpose.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002790_IXALICHIEFTAIN
16.description: Make mock of the Ixal, the Paragon does! Turns kin into puppets, pits brother against brother! Free them from his grasp, we shall!

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002800_KANESENNA
17.description: As Patriarch Za Da will attest, the Scions have granted us a means to free your brethren from their thralldom. This boon we will gladly share, that your people might never be enslaved again.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002840_THANCRED
21.description: It's taken a while, but I do believe we might be one step closer to a world without primals. Would that Minfilia were here to see it.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002850_ALISAIE
22.description: We still have a long way to go, and we're going to need a <hex:021A020203>lot<hex:021A020103> more porxies...but we're moving in the right direction.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002860_ALPHINAUD
23.description: If I may have your attention, there is one other point I would like to raise. As we can all agree, freeing those held captive must take precedence over every other concern.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002870_ALPHINAUD
24.description: But experience has taught us that none save those with the capacity to resist tempering can hope to enter the towers unscathed. And even once inside, a still greater threat may yet await them: that which we call a primal.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002880_ALPHINAUD
25.description: Needless to say, if we are to succeed, engaging with such foes can only ever be considered a last resort. And so I move that we seek to prevent them from being summoned in the first place.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002890_ZADA
26.description: Yes! Both prayer and aether are needed for the ritual. Should either one be denied, the summoning would fail!

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002900_ALPHINAUD
27.description: Indeed. And so we must endeavor to discover the source of the aether on which the process depends. Do so, and it may present a way to halt the summonings─or perhaps even neutralize the towers entirely.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002910_NANAMOULNAMO
28.description: A promising proposal. While you are conducting your investigations, however, we will need to remain vigilant, lest the Telophoroi commit further abductions, and summon primals ere we have the means to prevent them.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002920_NANAMOULNAMO
29.description: To stand a better chance of keeping our enemy at bay, we would do well to coordinate our defensive efforts, sending reinforcements to assist our neighbors when needed.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002930_AMALJAACHIEFTAIN
30.description: We Amalj'aa would have been overwhelmed were it not for our newfound allies. But say the word, and we shall come.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002940_AYMERIC
31.description: I see we are all in accord.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002950_AYMERIC
32.description: But what are we to call this proud fellowship of ours? I submit that the honor of naming it should go to the Scion whose brave efforts have done so much to unite Eorzea. What say you, my friend?

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
34.description: I would call it the Grand Company of Eorzea.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
35.description: I would...call it... One moment, please.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002970_ALISAIE
37.description: Might I suggest the Grand Company of Eorzea? I remember a certain someone pondering it once upon a time, and it seems as fitting a name as any.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002980_RAUBAHN
38.description: A fine choice. For there is none here who does not love Eorzea!

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_002990_MERLWYB
39.description: Aye! In that we shall ever be united!

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003000_KANESENNA
40.description: United in our gratitude for the realm that gave us life!

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003010_NANAMOULNAMO
41.description: Then let it be recorded that on this day the Grand Company of Eorzea was born!

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003020_ALPHINAUD
42.description: How long have we dreamed of this moment? And now that it's here, I... Forgive me. Might we speak outside?

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003030_FOURCHENAULT
43.description: Elder Seedseer, I thank you for granting me this audience.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003040_FOURCHENAULT
44.description: I am Fourchenault Leveilleur, here in my capacity as representative of the Forum.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003050_KANESENNA
45.description: It is I who should thank you, Master Fourchenault, for journeying so far, and so swiftly. Would that our first meeting could have been under happier circumstances.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003060_ALPHINAUD
46.description: It has been too long, Father. You look well.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003070_FOURCHENAULT
47.description: As do you both. Ameliance will be glad to hear that you are taking care of yourselves.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003090_FOURCHENAULT
49.description: She misses you terribly, of course, but is otherwise a picture of health.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003100_FOURCHENAULT
50.description: Circumstances apart, I am grateful that our meeting has afforded me the chance to be reunited with my children at long last. And I believe I also owe you thanks for the hospitality you showed my father, Louisoix, during his sojourn in Eorzea.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003110_KANESENNA
51.description: All thanks we owe to him. In the days prior to the Seventh Umbral Calamity, it was your father's tireless efforts which granted us a means to vanquish the primals.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003120_KANESENNA
52.description: Were it not for him, our strength would have been quite spent by the time the Empire arrived. That Gridania still stands is in large part his achievement. He was a great man.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003130_FOURCHENAULT
53.description: He would doubtless have been moved to hear you say so. I must confess, however, that I opposed his decision to intervene.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003150_KANESENNA
55.description: “To chart the course of history, not to change it.” I am familiar with the Sharlayans' stance.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003160_FOURCHENAULT
56.description: It is more than that. It is our way of life. Who we are.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003170_FOURCHENAULT
57.description: But I came here not to deliver a lecture, but the Forum's answer to your request.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003180_FOURCHENAULT
58.description: Sharlayan will under no circumstances intervene in the conflict between Eorzea and the Garlean Empire.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003190_KANESENNA
59.description: ...May I ask for what reason the Forum has come to this decision? The Final Days spell the end not only for Eorzea, but the entire world.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003200_FOURCHENAULT
60.description: The “Final Days”? Pray, spare me your hyperbole. This conflict is no more than the latest in a series of petty squabbles between yourselves and Garlemald. One in which Sharlayan will take no part. If the Final Days were truly upon us, we would know.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003210_ALPHINAUD
61.description: Father, you must ask the Forum to reconsider.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003220_ALPHINAUD
62.description: You may feel safe on your little island across the waves, but if you imagine the Telophoroi will leave you be, you are mistaken. They mean to kill us all, themselves included!

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003230_ALISAIE
63.description: Alphinaud is right. We have seen what the enemy is capable of, the lengths to which they'll go. This is no time to turn a blind eye.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003240_ALISAIE
64.description: If Eorzea falls, so too will Sharlayan. So if you truly love our homeland, you will join us─now, before it's too late!

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003260_FOURCHENAULT
66.description: I thought you knew better than to raise your voice to your elders. It seems I was wrong. Wrong to ever let you leave Sharlayan. I consoled myself that your time abroad would instill in you some hint of restraint, of discipline.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003270_FOURCHENAULT
67.description: But I see now that Eorzea has made fools of you both. Have you forgotten why it was that I so vehemently opposed your grandfather's departure?

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003280_FOURCHENAULT
68.description: For all his wisdom, his only solution was to go to war.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003290_FOURCHENAULT
69.description: Death. Devastation. Ruin. Even those who claim victory are scarred for life. What prize could ever justify such sacrifice?

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003300_FOURCHENAULT
70.description: It is the duty of the learned to avert such tragedy. By fanning the flames of war, you forsake all you once held dear.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
72.description: Better to fight and fail than wait for the axe to fall.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
73.description: To ignore the plight of those one might conceivably save is not wisdom─it is indolence.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_A2_000_003_NONE_VOICE
74.description: It is in your power to save us. Refuse and you condemn us all.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003310_FOURCHENAULT
75.description: I see your friend shares your misguided ideals. But unlike <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>, you should know better.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003320_FOURCHENAULT
76.description: By espousing such barbaric notions, you subvert the teachings of Sharlayan and place all we have worked for in jeopardy.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003330_FOURCHENAULT
77.description: Alphinaud, Alisaie. As of this moment, you shall no longer bear the name of Leveilleur.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003360_FOURCHENAULT
80.description: How you choose to live your lives is no longer my concern. If you wish to walk the path of ruin, I will not stand in your way.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003370_KANESENNA
81.description: Master Fourchenault! While Sharlayan may have no intention of intervening in this conflict, we can still part as friends. Will you not stay and speak with us, that we might learn of Sharlayan's hopes for the morrow?

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003380_FOURCHENAULT
82.description: I have said what I came here to say. Any further discussion would be meaningless.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003410_ALISAIE
85.description: How can you stand there and watch him walk away!? How can you let this happen!?

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003420_ALPHINAUD
86.description: Arenvald! I can't tell you how good it is to see you!

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003430_ARENVALD
87.description: It arrived a lot sooner than expected, eh? The day I crane my neck up at you...

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003440_ALPHINAUD
88.description: Only because you're sitting down. Unless...

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003450_ARENVALD
89.description: 'Fraid so. The chirurgeons say I may never walk again.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003460_ARENVALD
90.description: Come on, Alphinaud. It could be worse. Besides, I didn't come here to dampen the mood. Quite the opposite.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003470_ARENVALD
91.description: All I've ever wanted was to fight for a cause I believe in.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003480_ARENVALD
92.description: But my fighting days are over. So I want you to fight in my stead. Be the hero I can't.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003500_ARENVALD
94.description: That's what they all say, though. No one ever calls themselves a hero. Even the ones who eat primals for breakfast. It's for others to decide.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003501_ARENVALD
95.description: Look, Alphinaud... You already are a hero, to me and countless others. We see you doing your damndest to protect us all. And you're not alone, are you? There are people who believe in you, just as you believe in them.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_A3_000_001_NONE_VOICE
97.description: We carry the dreams of many. We'll carry yours too.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
98.description: We'll be sure to give your regards to the Telophoroi.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_A3_000_003_NONE_VOICE
99.description: Some things may have changed, but the adventure isn't over yet.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003510_ARENVALD
100.description: I know what's at stake, and how many people are depending on you. But I believe in you. Believe that you'll see it through.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003520_ARENVALD
101.description: That's why I'm entrusting my dreams to you. Like A'aba and Aulie once entrusted their dreams to me.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003530_ALPHINAUD
102.description: There was a time when I would have borne the weight of such expectations without a second thought.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003540_ALPHINAUD
103.description: But now...I know just how heavy that burden can be.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003550_ALPHINAUD
104.description: To tell the truth, I am beginning to wonder if I chose the right path. Sacrifices will inevitably be made for the sake of the ideals I uphold.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003560_ALPHINAUD
105.description: Maybe I am not the person I thought I was. The person you think I am.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003570_ARENVALD
106.description: I wouldn't presume to tell you. But I will say this...

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003580_ARENVALD
107.description: In spite of everything, you've come this far.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003590_ARENVALD
108.description: The road ahead might not always be clear, but you've never been one to give up or take the easy way out. And everything you do, you do for others. For a brighter future. I'm proud to call you my friend.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003600_ARENVALD
109.description: Well, I've said my piece, so I'll let you go. I know you've got more important things to be doing. Just...give what I've said some thought, all right?

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003610_ALPHINAUD
110.description: I shall, my friend. And we will meet again soon, I promise.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003620_ARENVALD
111.description: Nothing left for me to do but wave and smile.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003630_FORDOLA
112.description: You've got a pretty narrow view of what it means to be a hero, do you know that?

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003640_FORDOLA
113.description: You think they're all “forged in the fires of battle”? That it's all about being brave and killing villains?

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003650_FORDOLA
114.description: Alphinaud and the others will carry on their fight, but theirs isn't the only one. There are other ways you can make a difference─if you stop feeling sorry for yourself and put your bloody mind to it.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003660_ARENVALD
115.description: There's not much chance of me living the quiet life with you around, is there?

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003670_FORDOLA
116.description: If you're content to twiddle your thumbs, thinking of what might've been, that's your lookout. But I reckon you've got some fight left in you.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003680_ARENVALD
117.description: And I reckon you might be right. If there's a way I can still help my friends, I'll bloody well find it.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003690_ALPHINAUD
118.description: My fellow Scions... As I am sure you will have heard, we can expect no help from Sharlayan, nor are we any closer to discerning the Telophoroi's grand design.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003700_ALPHINAUD
119.description: And now, our adversary moves against us in unprecedented numbers, compelling us to answer in kind. The outlook, in short, is bleak. Yet though our foes are many, and we but few, we may still tip the balance in Eorzea's favor.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003710_THANCRED
120.description: Of course. We will do what we always do: deal with the ones our allies can't.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003720_THANCRED
121.description: A less-than-daunting prospect, judging by your expression. Could it be that you've dispelled your lingering doubts, Alphinaud?

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003730_ALPHINAUD
122.description: Oh, I doubt I ever will. But as my friends have kindly reminded me, I have come this far, and that must count for something.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003740_ALISAIE
123.description: Gods be good, Alphinaud! That's what we've been trying to tell you all along.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003750_ESTINIEN
124.description: For one so bright, you can be remarkably dim at times. There is such a thing as overthinking, you know.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003760_GRAHATIA
125.description: Might I suggest that we continue this conversation <hex:021A020203>after<hex:021A020103> the battle? It would appear the Telophoroi have already arrived.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003770_ALISAIE
126.description: I'll do what I can to cure the tempered, but they'll have to be incapacitated first.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003780_URIANGER
127.description: Have care, my friends, for none can say wherefore our foe did choose this fateful field to be our battleground. Whatever may transpire, pray grant him not the pleasure of deterring you.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003790_FANDANIEL
128.description: And thus another plan went up in smoke! I am beginning to see why Lord Zenos thinks so highly of you...

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003800_FANDANIEL
129.description: Not that this changes anything, you understand. You have merely earned yourself a stay of execution.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003830_ALISAIE
132.description: We've treated as many as we can. But some were beyond help...

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003840_AMALJAAWARRIOR
133.description: Do not hang your heads so, brave Scions.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003850_AMALJAAWARRIOR
134.description: Though not all of our captured brethren could be saved, we are grateful for those whose minds have been restored.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003860_AMALJAAWARRIOR
135.description: You could do no more. And that is enough. So please, hold your heads high.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003870_ALISAIE
136.description: I should've been quicker... But I'll do better next time.

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003880_ALISAIE
137.description: Thank you for your kind words. They mean a lot.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003890_ALPHINAUD
138.description: A victory at great cost...but a victory nonetheless.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003900_ALPHINAUD
139.description: We must stay strong and press on. Isn't that right?

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_A4_000_001_NONE_VOICE
141.description: One battle at a time, we'll get there.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003940_ALPHINAUD
147.description: It really must count for something.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003950_FANDANIEL
149.description: Those Eorzeans certainly are a stubborn bunch, though I suppose you knew that already.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003960_FANDANIEL
150.description: My plan to redirect the aether from Carteneau came to a rather less-than-satisfactory conclusion. It was, in many respects, an abject failure.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003970_FANDANIEL
151.description: Which does of course raise the question of where we are going to procure the requisite amount. The obvious solution would be to draw on resources a little closer to home, though that would require our dreamer to dream a trifle more deeply...

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003980_ZENOS
152.description: So be it. The dreamer will not complain.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_003990_FANDANIEL
153.description: Then let us begin the preparations at once. With the “gateway of the gods” complete, all that remains is to gather the necessary aether, and our prize shall be within reach!

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_004000_FANDANIEL
154.description: The time has come to fulfill your heart's desire! My desire!

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_004010_FANDANIEL
155.description: To relieve those wretched creatures of their meaningless existence!

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_004020_ZENOS
156.description: While I await you, I shall drink a sea of souls and gorge myself upon the darkened moon.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_004030_ZENOS
157.description: Then you shall come to me, all roiling rage and rancor...

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_004040_ZENOS
158.description: And the stars shall bear witness to our final contest.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_004050_YSHTOLA
159.description: As I thought... The aetherial currents have been disturbed here, too.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_004060_THANCRED
160.description: It was the same in Thanalan. Make that every location we surveyed.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_004070_GRAHATIA
161.description: And the strength of each current has diminished dramatically. Far more than could be attributed to a natural occurrence.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_004080_URIANGER
162.description: What tidings bringest thou from Dravania?

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_004090_ALPHINAUD
163.description: We took a number of readings, and noticed that the closer we were to the tower, the lower the aetheric density became. In short...

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_004100_ALISAIE
164.description: The towers are drawing upon the land's aether. Which would explain how they were able to carry out the summonings.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_004110_THANCRED
165.description: Our allies must be informed of this. We should return to the Rising Stones and have Tataru relay our findings to them.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05505_004140_MYSTERIOUSLADY
168.description: The fate...of the star...is in your hands...
